text.title: What The Disk Says To Do
text.summary: Routing from an observed state directory to one action: enrol, dispatch, wait, dead-letter, roll back, or do nothing. Every branch reads only files, so a tick needs no memory of the previous tick.

decision-tree.root-question: For this unit id: does its state directory exist, what is the latest phase with a marker, which marker is it, and how old is it?

conclusion.verdict: Create the directory, write meta.txt with identity and provenance, append the first history line. This is the ONLY branch permitted to create a directory.

STOP. Exit non-zero and name the unit id in the error. Do not create anything: an unknown id at this point is a typo, and creating for it produces a phantom unit that the dispatcher will treat as unstarted work.

branch.when: state_dir_exists == true AND no marker at the next lineage phase

conclusion.verdict: Write phase-<next>.in-flight with the timestamp and agent id FIRST, append the history line, then dispatch. Never the other order.
WAIT. Do nothing this tick. A phase in progress is the normal case and the commonest cause of double-dispatch is impatience with a slow one.

branch.when: marker == in-flight AND age >= dead_letter_after_minutes AND agent_alive == true

conclusion.verdict: WAIT, and raise the threshold in the spec. The unit is legitimately long-running; the number was set against the average phase instead of the longest.

branch.when: marker == in-flight AND age >= dead_letter_after_minutes AND agent_alive == false

conclusion.verdict: DEAD-LETTER. Append the line, move the unit to the operator queue, do not re-dispatch automatically — a blind resume runs ahead of the rate-limit gate and every resumed dispatch is full-price uncached input.

RETRY is permitted here and only here: the phase declared its own failure, so nothing downstream consumed its output. Re-dispatch the same phase; escalate to the operator on the third consecutive failure.

branch.when: marker == done AND output judged wrong

conclusion.verdict: ROLL BACK, do not retry. Truncate markers at and after this phase in lineage order, append rolled-back with the reason, requeue there with an amended brief. Retrying in place leaves the downstream phases that already consumed the bad artefact.

branch.when: marker == done AND phase == last in lineage

conclusion.verdict: COMPLETE. Append the final line and stop reading this unit. The history, not the marker set, is what gets archived.
